meta.title: The award proposal page: "Document" — record what happens

steps.note: Open Master QCS on the prepared closed RFQ with an award proposal.
Open the existing award proposal from Master QCS.
Confirm the award proposal page is ready before testing Document.
Click the Document control and record whether it opens anything or changes the page, without confirming any dialog.
Verify the browser remains on the proposal page, matching the expected lack of visible change.
